custom_prompts.name: Drizzle: Create Schema
custom_prompts.prompt: Create a Drizzle ORM schema for a {{name}} table using TypeScript. Include fields for {{fields}}. Ensure you import necessary functions from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'.

custom_prompts.name: Convex: Define Mutation
custom_prompts.prompt: Write a Convex mutation function in TypeScript named '{{name}}' that {{description}}. Ensure you import 'mutation' from './_generated/server'.

custom_prompts.name: Next.js: New API Route
custom_prompts.prompt: Create a Next.js App Router API route handler in 'app/api/{{routeName}}/route.ts'. It should handle a {{method}} request to {{description}}. Use TypeScript.
